# The Pressure Academy

> Public website for The Pressure Academy, including the main site and public Mastery Method pages.
> This file lists public-facing pages only. Protected portal routes and internal docs are intentionally excluded.

- https://thepressureacademy.com/ - The Pressure Academy brand family, training, apparel and academy orders. Pressure Planner is in development.
- https://thepressureacademy.com/privacy-policy.html - Privacy policy covering site forms, Mastery Method booking, scorecard submissions, and portal/session handling.
- https://thepressureacademy.com/shop/ - Storefront for pre-order requests. Physical goods are quoted for the requested destination. Prices shown in Australian dollars (AUD).
- https://thepressureacademy.com/shop/apparel/ - Pressure Tested apparel pre-order requests. Tee AUD 69, crop tee AUD 65, hoodie AUD 129, crop hoodie AUD 109. Standard tee and hoodie photographs show the artwork. The Academy confirms availability and delivery before payment.
- https://thepressureacademy.com/shop/apparel/drops/ - A first look at Pressure Tested apparel.
- https://thepressureacademy.com/shop/mats/ - Tatami mat pre-order requests. Each 2 m × 1 m mat covers 2 m² and costs AUD 138. Minimum 10 mats (20 m²), AUD 1,380 before freight. Ruby Red, Matte White, Jet Black, Rust Orange and Night Grey. Enquire for other colours.
- https://thepressureacademy.com/seminars/ - Seminar dates and event updates.
- https://thepressureacademy.com/seminars/michael-pixley-march-2027/ - The Pressure Academy hosts Michael Pixley in Brisbane, Queensland, Australia, in March 2027. Wrestling for Jiu Jitsu and Front Headlock are separate seminars, each capped at 20 people. Admission is AUD 150 per person for either seminar or AUD 300 for both. A separate 90-minute semi-private is AUD 1,000 per group of up to six. Optional Pressure Academy × Pixley tee AUD 69 or rashguard AUD 79 each. Exact dates and venue address to be confirmed. Submit a booking request for a reply about availability.
- https://thepressureacademy.com/blueprints/ - Grappling curriculum for coaches. Browse the Core System.
- https://thepressureacademy.com/blueprints/pressure-blueprint-core/ - Free coach’s PDF on request. Ten classes, 30 movements and a public butterfly guard lesson.
- https://thepressureacademy.com/academy-orders/ - B2B path for academies, clubs, and schools: mat fit-outs, team apparel, scoped quotes.
- https://thepressureacademy.com/contact/ - Contact and enquiry routing page.
- https://thepressureacademy.com/mastery-method/ - Mastery Method overview and main public landing page.
- https://thepressureacademy.com/mastery-method/about - Background on Mastery Method and its approach.
- https://thepressureacademy.com/mastery-method/clarity - Public explanation of The Mastery Method Framework.
- https://thepressureacademy.com/mastery-method/for-parents - Parent-focused explanation of how Mastery Method works.
- https://thepressureacademy.com/mastery-method/programs - Program structure and offer overview.
- https://thepressureacademy.com/mastery-method/pricing - Public pricing and offer summary.
- https://thepressureacademy.com/mastery-method/book - Booking and enquiry page for Learning Support Calls.
- https://thepressureacademy.com/mastery-method/scorecard - Public Clarity Scorecard page.
- https://thepressureacademy.com/mastery-method/resources - Public overview of Mastery Method resources.
